title: 1.2 The Origin of Domesticated Crops
description: Origins, selection criteria, and early uses of domesticated crops

questions.question: What is known about the exact place and time that agriculture began?
options: It is not possible to know the exact place and time that agriculture began
It is clearly known to have started in one fixed year in Mesopotamia
The exact place and date are recorded in ancient written texts
It began at the same time in all continents with precise records
questions.correctAnswer: It is not possible to know the exact place and time that agriculture began

questions.question: How is growing crops and rearing animals described in terms of time?
options: It is a deliberate activity that took a long time to develop
It was an accidental event that happened overnight
It developed within a single generation
It occurred instantly after the last ice age
questions.correctAnswer: It is a deliberate activity that took a long time to develop

questions.question: What did the evolution of agricultural economies do to wild plant species?
options: It transformed wild plant species to the fully domesticated ones
It caused wild plant species to remain exactly the same forever
It eliminated all wild plant species completely
It made wild plants grow without any human influence
questions.correctAnswer: It transformed wild plant species to the fully domesticated ones

questions.question: How might religion have influenced agriculture?
options: Particular animals and plants were kept as they were required for religious practices
Religion forbade all forms of crop cultivation
Religion made agriculture impossible in all societies
Religion had no effect on which plants were grown
questions.correctAnswer: Particular animals and plants were kept as they were required for religious practices

questions.question: How long did the change from hunter-gatherer culture to agriculture take place?
options: Over thousands of years
Over a few weeks
Within one year
In just a single decade
questions.correctAnswer: Over thousands of years

questions.question: What is said about evidence of how hunter-gatherers chose their food sources?
options: No strong evidence is available
Complete written records clearly explain their choices
Detailed accounts exist from all hunter-gatherer groups
Archaeological evidence shows exactly how they decided every food
questions.correctAnswer: No strong evidence is available

questions.question: What fair estimate is given about why hunter-gatherers selected certain plant species?
options: They were influenced by certain features of the plant species they selected as food sources
They chose plants randomly with no consideration of features
They selected plants based solely on their colour
They only selected plants that were completely unknown to others
questions.correctAnswer: They were influenced by certain features of the plant species they selected as food sources

questions.question: What did the selection of plant species as food source probably influence?
options: The domestication process of the plant species
The extinction of all animals in the region
The movement of tectonic plates
The formation of new oceans
questions.correctAnswer: The domestication process of the plant species

questions.question: Which feature could have been useful for hunter-gatherers in plant selection?
options: Ease of harvest
Difficulty in harvesting
Extremely long growing cycles with no predictability
Inability to be transported
questions.correctAnswer: Ease of harvest

questions.question: Which feature could have been useful for hunter-gatherers in plant selection?
options: Wide availability
Extreme rarity in all areas
Availability only once every century
Growing only in inaccessible mountain peaks
questions.correctAnswer: Wide availability

questions.question: Which feature could have been useful for hunter-gatherers in plant selection?
options: Ease of transport to the desired place
Being too heavy to carry any distance
Being impossible to move from growing site
Breaking apart immediately when touched
questions.correctAnswer: Ease of transport to the desired place

questions.question: Which of the following could also be desirable characteristics of plants selected for food?
options: High predictability and seasonal distribution
Unpredictable appearance with no seasonal pattern
Growing only at random times with no cycle
Appearing once in several decades unpredictably
questions.correctAnswer: High predictability and seasonal distribution

questions.question: Which characteristic could have been desirable for plant selection?
options: Climatic tolerance
Complete intolerance to any climate variation
Inability to survive in any known climate
Requirement for conditions that never occur
questions.correctAnswer: Climatic tolerance

questions.question: Which characteristic could have been desirable for plant selection?
options: Good flavour
Extremely bitter taste with no appeal
Unpleasant flavour making it inedible
Taste that caused immediate illness
questions.correctAnswer: Good flavour

questions.question: Which characteristic could have been desirable for plant selection?
options: Suitable grain size
Grain size too small to be useful
Grain size so large it was impossible to handle
No grains at all
questions.correctAnswer: Suitable grain size

questions.question: Which wild plant species did hunter-gatherers consume according to the handout?
options: Wild rice, grass species, wild oats and legumes
Only modern hybrid wheat varieties
Only genetically modified maize
Exclusively cultivated barley strains
questions.correctAnswer: Wild rice, grass species, wild oats and legumes

questions.question: What is known about legumes used by hunter-gatherers?
options: They are known to have been toxic
They were always completely safe and required no processing
They contained no harmful substances at all
They were only consumed after industrial processing
questions.correctAnswer: They are known to have been toxic

questions.question: How did hunter-gatherer societies use toxic legumes as food?
options: They detoxified and used the legumes as food
They ate them raw without any treatment
They used them only as fuel
They discarded them immediately without use
questions.correctAnswer: They detoxified and used the legumes as food

questions.question: On what basis were the detoxifying skills of hunter-gatherers developed?
options: Based on trial and error
Based on formal scientific laboratories
Based on advanced chemistry textbooks
Based on written pharmaceutical guides
questions.correctAnswer: Based on trial and error

questions.question: What did hunter-gatherers presumably do with poisonous substances extracted from toxic legumes?
options: They used them as poisons on arrowheads in hunting
They used them as sweeteners in food
They used them as medicine for all illnesses
They used them to fertilize crops
questions.correctAnswer: They used them as poisons on arrowheads in hunting

questions.question: Where were root crops widely used as food by hunter-gatherers?
options: Particularly in the tropical region
Exclusively in the Arctic region
Only in desert areas
Only in polar ice-covered regions
questions.correctAnswer: Particularly in the tropical region

questions.question: Which root crops are mentioned as important food sources for hunter-gatherers?
options: Wild onions and sweet potatoes
Only modern potatoes grown commercially
Only cultivated cassava hybrids
Only beetroot from temperate farms
questions.correctAnswer: Wild onions and sweet potatoes

questions.question: What sources of oil did hunter-gatherers use according to the handout?
options: Hunted animals and plant species such as coconut, oil palm and olive
Only petroleum products from underground
Only synthetic oils made from chemicals
Only oils from modern factories
questions.correctAnswer: Hunted animals and plant species such as coconut, oil palm and olive

questions.question: Which plant species are mentioned as oil sources used by hunter-gatherers?
options: Coconut, oil palm and olive
Wheat, barley and rye
Maize, teff and sorghum
Rice, oats and millet
questions.correctAnswer: Coconut, oil palm and olive

questions.question: Which of the following was a likely consideration for hunter-gatherers when selecting plants?
options: Plants with high predictability and seasonal distribution
Plants that grew randomly throughout the entire year
Plants that appeared only during natural disasters
Plants with no fixed growing season
questions.correctAnswer: Plants with high predictability and seasonal distribution

questions.question: What role did trial and error play in the use of legumes by hunter-gatherers?
options: It helped them develop detoxifying skills
It helped them create synthetic fertilizers
It enabled them to build permanent buildings
It allowed them to develop metal tools
questions.correctAnswer: It helped them develop detoxifying skills
